proofs.text: Build the brief for a `[risk: low]` rule in a recorded project; verify its layers are exactly `proof text` and `test body`
Build the brief for that same low-risk rule; verify its test strength is `none` because the strength layer did not run

rule_text: A low-risk rule's brief runs the proof-text and test-body layers and no others, so its test strength is never read

tests.body:
def test_low_risk_stops_after_the_free_checks(self, proved):
        assert build(proved, 'RULE-1')['layers'] == ['proof text', 'test body']
tests.name: test_low_risk_stops_after_the_free_checks
